output.summary: KEP-5008 proposes moving the Headlamp project and its maintainers under Kubernetes SIG UI, with the headlamp-k8s/headlamp repository moved into the kubernetes-sigs GitHub organization. The KEP is in provisional status.
output.rationale: The proposal aims to improve the Kubernetes graphical UI experience, including flexibility and desktop experience, by bringing Headlamp under SIG UI. The stated motivation is a good out-of-the-box experience for end users and a base for vendors and other projects to build on. Only the core headlamp repository moves; the plugins and website repositories are left for possible later moves.

alternatives.option: Move the plugins and website repositories together with the core repository
alternatives.why_not: The proposal states that it entails only the move of the headlamp-k8s/headlamp repository; other repositories may be proposed later.

alternatives.option: Require existing Dashboard users to migrate to Headlamp
alternatives.why_not: The Non-Goals section states the proposal does not propose to force people who are using the current Dashboard to move to Headlamp.

evidence.quote: This proposal entails only the move of the headlamp-k8s/headlamp repository under the kubernetes-sig organization.
This proposal does not propose to force people who are using the current Dashboard to move to Headlamp.
The proposal is to continue the development of Headlamp as part of the Kubernetes project, under the auspices of Kubernetes SIG UI.
